rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained. Collectibles gain or loss on Form 8949 Part II is refused at the transaction: `sales.one` refuses when `sales.special` ("Direct sales of collectibles, section 1202 stock and section 1250 property are unsupported"), and the refusal reaches Form 1040 line 7a through `sd.count`. Line 1 is zero only behind that refusal. No change to the data.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: refusal located elsewhere; project retained. A code Q exclusion arises from a sale of qualified small business stock, refused at the transaction by sales.special ('qualified small business stock with a section 1202 exclusion'), from Form 1099-DIV box 2c, refused by div.section1202 ('Form 8949 code Q / Form 6251'), or from a Schedule K-1, refused by sd.other_forms; each refusal reaches line 7 of this worksheet and Form 1040 line 7a. Line 2 is zero only behind them. No change to the data.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained. rulings.ruling: Ruling: refusal located elsewhere; project retained. A long-term capital loss carryover (Schedule D line 14) is refused by sd.carryover ('Is there a capital loss carried into 2025 from any earlier year?'), and a Schedule K-1 (Form 1041) box 11 code D amount by sd.other_forms ('capital gains or losses on a Schedule K-1') and scope.schedule1 ('estates or trusts (Schedule E or a Schedule K-1)'); both refuse line 7 of this worksheet and Form 1040 line 7a (checked: sd.carryover true gives g28.line7 refused). A carryover must be entered here as a loss when carryovers come into scope. No change to the data.
